sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: A round shield of overlapping slick green-grey scales catches the light like river-water. It smells of deep water, mud, and old teeth.

sections.title: Public role
sections.body: Eeligator Scale Shield: sharp-scaled river armor. Add +1 to damage thresholds and +2 to damage rolls.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: HEXMART REMINDS YOU: Genuine eeligator scale is unregulated wildlife and may carry opinions. Try Hexmart Scale-Look Shielding instead.
